settingsPage.builtinDeleteDisabled: Built-in patch sources cannot be deleted yet
settingsPage.wsusUrlHelp: Enter the WSUS server address and service port. The platform backend must also be able to reach this server over WinRM. For example: http://10.10.22.44:8530.
settingsPage.yumRepoUrlHelp: Enter the actual repository directory. The system reads repodata/repomd.xml under this URL. For example: https://mirrors.aliyun.com/rockylinux/8/BaseOS/x86_64/os/.
settingsPage.dnfRepoUrlHelp: Enter the actual repository directory. The system reads repodata/repomd.xml under this URL. For example: https://mirrors.aliyun.com/rockylinux/9/BaseOS/x86_64/os/.
settingsPage.aptRepoUrlHelp: Enter the APT repository root. The system reads the security/main Packages.gz index for the selected system version and CPU architecture. For example: https://mirrors.aliyun.com/ubuntu (set the system version to 24.04).
settingsPage.hourlyTrigger: Automatically assess all targets every {count} hours
settingsPage.dailyTrigger: Automatically assess all targets daily at {time}
settingsPage.weeklyTrigger: Automatically assess all targets on {weekday} at {time}
settingsPage.triggerBaselineBound: A target enters pending assessment when first bound to a baseline
settingsPage.triggerBaselineChanged: A target resets to pending assessment when its baseline or requirements change
settingsPage.triggerManual: Runs immediately when Assess Now is selected
settingsPage.triggerPostRemediation: Verifies automatically after installation or reboot
settingsPage.scheduleHelp: When enabled, the system periodically assesses all target compliance. Disabling it stops automatic scheduled tasks; manual assessments are unaffected.
